result.summary: Several layout and content-cut-off issues: category chips and restaurant cards overflow the screen, restaurant names are truncated, and a promo card is clipped at the bottom.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row (Trattoria Piccol…) is clipped at the right edge, so the name and image are incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding or a peek/carousel fade so cards don’t get cut off, or wrap/scale the last visible card fully on screen.

issues.description: The last category filter chip ('Healthy') is cut off at the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the chip row has enough end padding or allow full swipe so the last chip is fully visible.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated without an ellipsis or full name visible.
issues.suggestion: Show the full name on two lines or use a proper ellipsis and tooltip/accessible label for the complete name.

issues.description: The bottom popular restaurant card is cut off by the tab bar, so the restaurant name, rating, and details are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the tab bar height so cards can scroll fully above the navigation.

issues.description: Promo banner text sits on a busy green pattern; the white body copy may be harder to read depending on the overlay.
issues.suggestion: Increase overlay contrast or add a subtle text shadow/scrim behind the promo copy.
